description: This is a Java unit test class for ImmutablePermissions, testing its immutability, equality, permissions creation, and JSON representation.

classes.name: ImmutablePermissionsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImmutablePermissions to verify immutability, equality, creation, and JSON representation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating an empty ImmutablePermissions instance.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ImmutablePermissions instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode methods via EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: createNewMutablePermissionsFromGivenSet
methods.description: Creates an ImmutablePermissions instance from a set of permissions and verifies its contents.

methods.name: containsWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the contains method correctly reports permissions.

methods.name: createJsonRepresentationOfEmptyMutablePermissions
methods.description: Tests that the JSON representation of empty permissions is an empty JSON array.
